rationale: The mechanism is the argument with unusual precision: pointermove is literally the primitive on which every heatmap and session-replay vendor runs, so a follower that uses it to enact Acconci's pursuit while refusing to persist anything stages the catalogue's anti-surveillance ethic as form, not as wall text. Double-coding is clean — the surface gag (a thing chases my cursor) carries a literate argument about where the violation in surveillance actually sits (the keeping, not the following). The 'only ethical stalker' line and the standing 'recorded: nothing · 0 bytes' ledger are the kind of restraint-plus-wit the DNA rewards. Distinct from the pointer-driven 'this way browser' (which is about Brouwn's measured walking) and from other catalogue entries.
reservations: The P5 chance/order claim is the weakest invocation: the work is genuinely order (deterministic easing) plus external chance (human hand), but it does not visibly stage the tension the way Maleglitch or A Chance of Order do. Per-visit hue is a minor gesture rather than a meaningful parameter, and the easing constant (0.075) is hard-coded rather than treated as material.
revision_suggestion: To thicken P5, make the easing curve itself a per-visit generated function (e.g., easing constant drawn from a small ordered set mapped against date or visit index), so the order/chance axis is felt in the follower rather than only narrated in the rationale. Optionally add one more dry line of label prose — the current wall text is tight but slightly under-delivers the 'keeping is the violation' thesis that the code already performs.
